content.title: Sidemen Charity Match ratings as YouTube Allstars win 20-goal thriller after penalty shootout
content.text: Penalties were needed to separate SDMN FC and the YouTube Allstars at Wembley Stadium and the Sidemen Charity Match title stayed putThe Sidemen Charity Match was won by the YouTube Allstars at Wembley Stadium as 90,000 fans watched a 20-goal extravaganza and penalty shootout. Exactly £6,218,875 was raised for charity by the end of the match, streamed on YouTube.Football historian Steve Bolton analyses first footage of women's gameIn the seventh renewal of the fan-favourite charity game, we were treated to eight goals in the first half before Tinie Tempah took to the turf for the half-time show. This year marked the first time that the Sidemen had split up between the two teams, with KSI, Miniminter and Behzinga changing allegiances and representing the YouTube Allstars.The match went to penalties after finishing 10-10, with both managers taking the first spot-kicks for their teams. But after coach Jack Joseph's miss, SDMN FC only converted once from the spot and the Allstars kept their title, winning the shootout 4-1.Miniminter added three goals to his all-time scoring record in the match, bringing his total to 14, but Jynxzi won Man of the Match and Mirror Football rates the performances of all the YouTubers, influencers and streamers at Wembley.JOIN US ON FACEBOOK! Latest news, analysis and much more on Mirror Football's Facebook pageSDMN FCXQC - 2Was responsible for a good few of the goals and made it a shoot-on-sight type of game for the YouTube Allstars.AmineMaTue - 5The Twitch streamer enjoyed a quiet afternoon.Wroetoshaw - 6Didn't put a foot wrong in the game, but saw his minutes limited.Marlon - 8After an early substitution faux pas, Marlon bagged a goal and an assist and looked composed on the field.Deji - 4His highlight was suplexing two members of the opposition early on.TBJZL - 7The usually unstoppable Toby grabbed just the one in the game and could have done better, but that strike was the goal of the match.Chris MD - 9The Jerseyman was the engine of the SDMN FC midfield, providing an assist and claiming a rather unfortunate goal via a horrendous deflection. His penalty was simple.Zerkaa - 8Josh finally got his goal from open play this afternoon, converting from close range.Lazarbeam - 5A rather under-the-radar match from the Australian who thought he was playing Aussie Rules with his penalty.Niko Omilana - 8Omilana may not have been made Mayor of London or won Celebrity Traitors, but he has now scored at Wembley.Vikkstar123 - 8Vikkstar's goal sent the crowd wild.AB - 7His goal was impressive and it made up for some early errors.Adapt - 6Limited minutes for Adapt, who didn't make too much of a mark.AJ Shabeel - 6His penalty should have been saved and his goatee stops him from being given anything more than a six.Arthur TV - 9A great showing from the YouTube star, who grabbed three assists, striking the post with one shot.Jynxzi - 9Two goals redeemed his poor showing 12 months ago, and he was rightly awarded the Player of the Match award.Lacy - 6Another of SDMN FC's substitutes who didn't make any real impact.YouTube AllstarsSketch - 4He did make some high-profile errors but kept his team in the game early on after getting a whack to the face from a teammate in the opening minute.JasonTheWeen - 5Like a deer in headlights at times, his penalty was a weak one, too.Angryginge - 9The Soccer Aid star ran the show from the back. He headed home from a corner to kick-start the avalanche of goals and provided two assists - with an impressive celebration to boot.Mrwhosetheboss - 7He didn't do too much in regulation, but he won his team the game with a powerful penalty.Danny Aarons - 7His goal was a thing of beauty.Ibai - 7A lacklustre 90 minutes, but his penalty was a composed one.KSI - 9The captain led by example and provided two assists and a goal.Behzinga - 6A quiet game from one of the Sidemen defectors.CarryMinati - 6Another Allstar who didn't make a name for himself.Stable Ronaldo - 5Partnering Miniminter up top, he couldn't get on the scoreboard.Miniminter - 10As usual, Simon Minter was a level above a lot of his opponents. He scored another hat-trick and looked the class act.Max Fosh - 7He would have been given a six were it not for his yellow card trick.Chazza - 8A classy outing and goal to top things off.WillNE - 7He did find the back of the net, but his unsuccessful goal-line clearance in the first half drained a bit of aura.George Clarke - 6On the winning side but didn't contribute much.ItalianBach - 9ItalianBach stood out, with his goal from range taking the match to penalties.Squeezie - 5Started on the bench and didn't really get a sniff.Sky Sports, HBO Max, Netflix and Disney+ with Ultimate TV packageThis article contains affiliate links, we will receive a commission on any sales we generate from it.
